principle: Maintain facts once and project them into bounded human, Codex, and Claude views.

areas.title: Obsidian configuration
areas.purpose: Personal graph and vault display configuration; graph colors are validated while personal view state is preserved.

areas.title: Platform adapters
areas.purpose: Thin Codex and Claude access, installation, and lifecycle ownership around the shared router.

areas.title: Graph cards
areas.purpose: Human and Obsidian context for parked or legacy items; never a runtime routing source.

areas.title: Single-file skills
areas.purpose: Independent task skills whose canonical instructions live in one Markdown file each.

areas.title: Documentation and governance
areas.purpose: Machine maintenance authorities, architecture records, build guidance, and the derivative human learning route.

areas.title: External skill pointers
areas.purpose: Declared links to skills owned by another repository; external targets are never traversed by the documentation generator.

areas.title: Interaction protocol
areas.purpose: Shared general and equation-led response behavior composed with task routing without consuming the task-skill slot.

areas.title: Repository protocols
areas.purpose: Operation-specific rules and machine contracts for safe additions, edits, migrations, moves, deletion, installation, and amendments.

areas.title: Skill registry
areas.purpose: Canonical family, trigger, exclusion, path, and activation metadata used to compile the runtime manifest.

areas.title: Change-request inbox
areas.purpose: Narrow review packets created by tasks outside this repository; requests are never skill or routing authority.

areas.title: Packaged research skill
areas.purpose: Repository-owned human-guided research orientation with shared initial and deepening phases, evidence rules, and thin platform wrappers.

areas.title: Shared runtime
areas.purpose: Platform-neutral routing protocol, API, compiled manifest, and compact agent-entry source.

areas.title: Deterministic tools
areas.purpose: Local, bounded commands that compile, route, validate, scan, benchmark, install, and generate repository views.

areas.title: Initial skill plans
areas.purpose: Lightweight, unimplemented skill ideas containing only one plan.md; they are not skills or routing sources.

areas.title: Verification
areas.purpose: Prompt fixtures and unit or lifecycle tests that prove routing, safety, documentation, and maintenance behavior.

areas.title: Packaged theory skill
areas.purpose: A separately owned Git submodule with thin platform wrappers, shared phase instructions, rules, templates, and support scripts.

artifact_overrides..gitignore: Declares repository-local paths Git should not track.
artifact_overrides..gitmodules: Pins the separately owned theory-reference Git submodule.
artifact_overrides.AGENTS.md: Generated standalone Codex repository entry containing shared rules plus the Codex lifecycle overlay.
artifact_overrides.CLAUDE.md: Generated standalone Claude repository entry containing shared rules plus the Claude hook overlay.
artifact_overrides.README.md: Human-facing entry and progressive learning map; it is never runtime routing authority.
artifact_overrides.adapters/codex/ENTRY.md: Canonical Codex-only invocation and session-ownership overlay used to generate AGENTS.md.
artifact_overrides.adapters/claude/ENTRY.md: Canonical Claude-only hook, child-lifecycle, and acceptance overlay used to generate CLAUDE.md.
artifact_overrides.runtime/AGENT_ENTRY_SHARED.md: Canonical agent rules shared by generated Codex and Claude repository entries.
artifact_overrides.runtime/router-manifest.json: Generated compact routing and activation data consumed by the one-shot router.
artifact_overrides.docs/human/_LIVE_REPOSITORY_INDEX.md: Generated exhaustive human reference for repository files, ownership, roles, and purposes.
artifact_overrides.docs/human/_LIVE_SKILL_CATALOG.md: Generated human reference for live skills, triggers, exclusions, states, and package contents.

packages.purpose: Small shared response contract with a human graph entry and a canonical JSON source.
Multi-file theory skill with platform wrappers, shared phases, rules, templates, and scripts.
Human-guided early research orientation with shared initial/deepening phases, evidence rules, a project record template, and thin platform wrappers.
Externally owned career workflow pointer; Skills AI controls only its registry state.
